name: Washington Attorney General Data Breach Notifications
unit_of_observation: One notice submitted to the Attorney General, joined to zero or more source information-type rows
source_threshold: The source states that notice to the Attorney General is required when more than 500 Washington residents are affected.
source_population: Notifications affecting Washington residents since July 24, 2015.
public_window: Historical public datasets from August 2015 to present.
source_licence: The dataset has no dataset-specific licence identifier. Data.wa.gov states its content may generally be used free for most purposes unless restrictions are documented.
attribution: Washington State Attorney General's Office Consumer Protection Division
correction_process: Check the current Socrata row and dataset metadata; preserve the notifying-entity role.
limitations: The named entity is the notifier and is nearly always the data owner, not necessarily the entity where the event occurred.
Dataset-specific licence metadata is absent and requires ongoing review.
